releases.name: Neon & Bones
releases.summary: Las Vegas, 1957. Every night you split the casino's take four ways: the tax man, Chicago, your crew and your own pocket. Skim too little and the Family sends a car; too much and the FBI opens a file. Build an empire, then buy your way out.

releases.name: Little Lua & The Lost Six
releases.summary: Six kids are torn from their world and dropped into Everbloom, a realm poisoned by the Blight. Build your squad, master fire, ice, and lightning magic, and fight your way through shifting seasons to free everyone the Blight has taken — including your own parents.

releases.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
releases.summary: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

releases.name: Keep The Ammo Flowing
releases.summary: A top-down incremental logistics and tower-defense game. Mine resources, produce ammunition, build tracks toward the exit, and upgrade your mobile furnace and turret while defending it from underground swarms.

releases.name: Token Club: AI Desktop Pet
releases.summary: A desktop pet for people who code with AI. When you prompt your agent (Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity), your mascot runs to the stage and dances while customers throw bills worth what that prompt costs at API prices.

releases.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
releases.summary: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.

releases.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
releases.summary: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

releases.name: Gorse Roll
releases.summary: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that traces every change as you make it.

releases.name: Who fed the cat?
releases.summary:
Great-Aunt Ada isn't home. She has left you her house, a note in every room and one of her ball machines in each, with a few parts missing. 

The ball has to reach the basket, the hoop, the cup or the fruit bowl. Pick up the pieces, put them where you think they go, press Play and watch. If the ball ends up under the sofa, rewind and try again.

Play on your own, or online with a friend: share a room code and build the same machine together. Either of you can pick up any piece or press Play.

releases.name: DeepBreaker
releases.summary: Break through solid rock with your bare hands. Smash blocks, upgrade your power at the Workbench, unlock stronger gloves, fight enemies, and uncover what lies beyond the walls.

releases.name: Cat Survivor
releases.summary: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.

releases.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
releases.summary: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.

releases.name: IcerKid
releases.summary: Welcome to IcerKid! Dive into a chilly, fast-paced puzzle-action adventure where your goal is to survive and conquer dynamic levels. Strategy, control, and thinking skills are required to advance to higher levels and compete on global leaderboards.

releases.name: Party Home: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Clean up after the party in this cozy first-person co-op game! Put every item back where it belongs, scrub away the stains, toss the trash and play satisfying mini-games – solo or with a friend, online or split-screen – before Mom gets home.

releases.name: Deepest Maze
releases.summary: Explore a cursed labyrinth filled with deadly monsters and hidden treasures. Defeat enemies, level up, master skills, and collect gear. Recruit NPCs as companions, fight powerful foes, overcome countless dangers, and reach the deepest depths!

releases.name: Night Wash: GE-418-NK
releases.summary: Night shift at a tunnel car wash on the edge of town. Take the money, log the plates, keep the brushes turning until six. The attendant before you stopped coming three weeks ago. His notes are still in the drawer.

releases.name: Dad's Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
GIFT from GOD
releases.summary: GIFT from GOD is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

releases.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
releases.summary: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.

releases.name: Prayer Chest
releases.summary: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

releases.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey
releases.summary: A simple 2-4 hour RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles.

releases.name: My Bookstore
releases.summary: Start with empty shelves and a dream in My Bookstore! Buy books, manage your inventory, serve customers, and grow your little shop into a thriving bookstore. Stock your shelves, ring up sales, and build the bookstore every book lover dreams of!

releases.name: Northfall
releases.summary: Northfall is a god-forsaken place where every dawn brings a new fight for survival. Explore abandoned territories, gather invaluable resources, and expand your camp. Face the infected and prove you can survive in a world that forgives no mistakes.

releases.name: Musunoa: The Faceless
releases.summary:
Lanterns light the streets of Seirin for a night of celebration. Then the first houses catch fire. Soldiers emerge from the darkness, strike and vanish.

Ren refuses to let them escape. Pursuing the attackers, he discovers an entire army beyond the river. His village is still tending its wounded. If he loses the crossing, the attackers will reach its gates before the villagers can escape.

Alongside Aya, Ren enters a war that leads him back to the secrets of his own family. Behind enemy masks and the silence of those closest to him, he searches for the same answer: who can he still trust?

Take command in a turn-based strategy adventure. Hold the crossings, advance through the fog and prepare your attacks: the soldiers you lead are the last line of defense between your village and the approaching army.

releases.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
releases.summary: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

releases.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
releases.summary: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

releases.name: Hero Tower Defense
releases.summary: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

releases.name: No Visitors Allowed
releases.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

releases.name: Haunted Echoes
releases.summary: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

releases.name: My Galaxy Buddy
releases.summary: A relaxing idler that sits on your desktop. Interact with it on your own terms while you work on other tasks! Extract items from 8 unique biomes! Purchase upgrades to discover rare planets!Customize your UFO and extract items in style!Discover all biomes and collect every item to fill out your archive!

releases.name: WE'RE ALL IN!
releases.summary: ROLL ROLL ROLL! An online 1-4 player co-op physics-based “rube-goldberg-like” gambling game! Place ramps, cannons, turrets, and other contraptions in the name of maximum Dopamine. Unlock zany items to harass your friends, avoid dangerous side effects of gambling, and survive the clinic trial…

releases.name: DUMMY HOUSE
releases.summary: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

releases.name: Cats to Mars
releases.summary: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

releases.name: Prison Legacy
releases.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

releases.name: Behelade
releases.summary: Wield the “Behelade” to fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up and find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the animals go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

releases.name: Resettle
releases.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

releases.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
releases.summary: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

releases.name: Peaceward Chronicles
releases.summary: A turn-based card strategy game set in the Taiping Rebellion. Guided by Heaven, you become Hong Xiuquan, God's second son. Unlock characters, build a team, and exploit Five Elements matchups and formation bonuses. Complete six story chapters; unlock roguelike challenges after Chapter 2.

releases.name: Last Bake
releases.summary: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...
